content.text: ▪︎unknown etiology, ⍉contagious; lungs + skin MC affected; myocardial + kidney manifestations also poss
▪︎poss causative factors: genetics, chemical exposure, community outbreak; greater exposure to inhaled toxins → ↑risk
: unknown Ag triggers cell-mediated immune response characterized by accum of T cells & macrophages, release of cytokines & chemokines, & organization of responding cells into granulomas
▪︎inflam response (T cells, macrophages, fibroblasts) destroys surrounding healthy tissue → granulomas
lesions on nose, cheeks, chin, & ears
▪︎Löfgren = acute form of sarcoidosis; arthritis typically bilat ankles
▪︎constitutional: myalgias, fatigue, wt loss, anorexia, chills, night sweats, nonproductive cough
▪︎pulm Sx MC; may progress to SOB, effusion, or PTX

▪︎cutaneous (25%): EN = erythematous, painful, warm patches + nodules on shins, arms + buttocks; lupus pernio (indurated, purple; lips, nose, cheeks, around eyes) = pathognomonic, may indicate pulm sarcoid; also nail clubbing, alopecia, skin hypo-/hyperpigmentation
▪︎DDx: autoimmune (GPA, Churg-Strauss), infect (mycobacterial, toxoplasmosis), malig (lymphoma), chemical exposure (aluminum, talc, beryllium)
▪︎prognosis relatively good: rarely fatal, may spontaneously resolve; good health practices, ⍉smoke
▪︎also ⇡ CRP; serum ACE often used to assess dz activity
▪︎restrictive or obstructive pattern; ⍉perform b4 transbronchial BX
▪︎CXR in all pts w/ sus sarcoidosis
▪︎poss reticulonodular opacities in upper lung fields
▪︎CXR esp helpful (90% pulm involvement); stage = level of lung involvement, ⍉necessarily dz severity
▪︎stage IV: honeycombing, hilar retractions, bullous cysts; least favorable prognosis
▪︎bx an accessible lesion: skin lesion, LN, or subcut nodule
▪︎dx: prompt ID of EN, uveitis + BHL on CXR; transbronchial lung BX = dx test of choice
Gallium scintigraphy: lambda sign (⇡uptake around hilar nodes + trachea), panda sign (⇡uptake around lacrimal + parotid glands)
▪︎tx of choice; typically up to 6mo b4 taper
▪︎MTX = alt if glucocorticoid SE profile undesirable
▪︎severe/end-stage pulm dz or progressive despite pharm → lung transplant
